description: Source code for the 'Emails' module in a CRM system, defining the Emails class with methods for managing email records, attachments, relationships, and export functionalities.

classes.name: Emails
classes.description: Represents the Emails module, handling email data, relationships, attachments, and export functions within the CRM system.

methods.name: Emails
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger, database connection, and column fields for the Emails class.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Saves email record and manages relationships with related entities and attachments.

methods.name: insertIntoAttachment
methods.description: Handles attachment insertion, including PDFs and file uploads, for email records.

methods.name: saveForwardAttachments
methods.description: Saves forwarded email attachments from IMAP mailbox into the system.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts related to a specific email record.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sorting order for email list views.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Returns the field by which email records are sorted.

methods.name: get_users
methods.description: Retrieves users associated with an email activity, with options for bulk mailing.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Generates SQL query for exporting email records with access control.

methods.name: set_emails_contact_invitee_relationship
methods.description: Creates relationship between email and contact.

methods.name: set_emails_se_invitee_relationship
methods.description: Creates relationship between email and sales entity.

methods.name: set_emails_user_invitee_relationship
methods.description: Creates relationship between email and user.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes relationships between email and other entities.

methods.name: getNonAdminAccessControlQuery
methods.description: Returns SQL snippet for access control based on user permissions.
